verdict: Ads have been paused since Sep 17; restart depends on overdue deliverables.
narrative: All 59 leads and $995 in ad spend this period came before September 17 — paid ads have been dark for the 15 days since. The pause is tied to eight outstanding setup milestones (including conversion tracking, landing pages, and ad creative) that are overdue and must be in place before campaigns can run responsibly. In parallel, Google Ads produced zero leads on $248 in spend even while Meta was active, so that budget is being redirected. On the pipeline side, your CRM shows 95 opportunities created against 59 leads reported and zero won — a gap we're working to understand at the intake level. Once the overdue items are delivered, ads will relaunch with the full attribution and creative infrastructure in place, and October's target is scaling Meta to optimize on actual client activations.
